behavior.title: WAF behavior

behavior.errorTitle: WAF behavior could not be shown.
behavior.forbidden: You do not have permission to view WAF behavior.
behavior.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
behavior.failed: WAF sources could not be loaded, so nothing is shown. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then reload the page. Nothing was changed.
behavior.emptyTitle: No WAF source has a behavior profile.
behavior.emptyText: Nothing is collected or judged until a log source is mapped and validated in WAF sources administration. An empty list here is not a statement that WAF traffic is normal.

sources.caption: WAF sources with profile and validation status for the current profile version, endpoint coverage of the latest collected bucket, active endpoints against the ceiling, and admission overflow in the selected range. Sources that need attention are listed first. Times are UTC.
sources.noBucketInRangeMeaning: no bucket was collected in this range
sources.keyBucketsMeaning: Counted per bucket: an endpoint key refused in several buckets of the range counts once for each of them.
sources.note: A key-bucket is one endpoint key in one collected bucket, so a key refused in several buckets counts once for each. Refused over quota means the key met the volume threshold but the per-bucket quota for new endpoints, or the source's active ceiling, was full. Below admission threshold is ordinary low-volume noise, not overflow.

endpoints.caption: Endpoints of this WAF source with baseline adequacy, when each was last seen, whether it is retired, and its worst detector state. An endpoint no detector has evaluated says so. Times are UTC.
endpoints.noDetector: No detector has judged this endpoint

incident.noVirtualHostOnEndpoint: No virtual host on this endpoint
incident.noVirtualHost: This WAF source does not expose a virtual host, so this endpoint may combine traffic for different applications that share the path.

metrics.title: Incident measurements
metrics.observedLower: At least this; the true value may be higher
metrics.observedCumulative: Cumulative since the endpoint first appeared, not a per-bucket rate
metrics.expectedNone: The endpoint has no verified history, so no seasonal baseline applies
metrics.expectedSeasonal: Seasonal baseline, this weekday and hour
metrics.confidenceLimited: limited because baseline variability is zero
metrics.coverageNote: of the source's events carried a parseable endpoint

detection.none: No detector working was recorded for this incident, so its expected range and baseline cannot be shown. This is a missing record, not a normal baseline.

summary.lowerBound: The observed figure is a lower bound: the true value is at least this.
summary.requestRate: Requests to {endpoint} reached {observed} {unit}, against an expected {expected} {unit}.
summary.newEndpoint: {endpoint} received {observed} requests since it first appeared; none were expected, as it had no verified request history at the admission threshold.

ratio.block: The blocked share of requests for {endpoint} was {observed}{counts}, against an expected {expected}.
ratio.serverError: The HTTP 5xx share of responses for {endpoint} was {observed}{counts}, against an expected {expected}.
ratio.clientError: The HTTP 4xx share of responses for {endpoint} was {observed}{counts}, against an expected {expected}.
ratio.concentration: The largest source's share of requests for {endpoint} was {observed}{counts}, against an expected {expected}.

validation.staleKnown: VALID for v{validated}; profile is now v{version}
validation.staleOlder: VALID for an older profile; profile is now v{version}

investigation.timelineFailed: Request history for this endpoint could not be loaded. The rest of this investigation is unaffected, but the timeline is absent rather than empty.
investigation.expectedProportion: The expected proportion at detection was {share}.
investigation.expectedRange: The expected range at detection was {low} to {high} requests per bucket.
investigation.gapsRatio: {count} intervals had no measured proportion (not collected, failed, partial, not stored or no requests to divide) and are drawn as gaps, not as 0 %.
investigation.gapsVolume: {count} intervals were partial, missing or not stored and are drawn as gaps, not as zero requests.

table.label: WAF sources
table.caption: WAF sources with their mapping version, validation result, collection state and when they were last validated. Sources that need attention are listed first. Times are UTC.
table.notePaused: A mapping change pauses collection from that source until the new version validates. “Version 5 not validated” therefore means the source is paused, not that it is unhealthy.
table.noteDash: A dash means the source has never been validated. It is not a failed validation.

editor.noProfile: This log source has no WAF profile.
editor.createTail: Review the mapping, then create the profile. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
editor.mappingNote: The QRadar property each logical field is read from for this source. Changing a property pauses collection until the new version validates.
editor.productLabelNote: An operator note, for example the WAF product. Never parsed.
editor.formRejected: Not saved. The server rejected the mapping; see the message below.
editor.fixFields: Not saved. Fix the fields marked below; nothing was sent.
editor.cannotChange: Your role cannot change WAF sources (permission admin:waf). Nothing was changed.
editor.cannotRead: Your role cannot read WAF sources (permission admin:waf). Nothing was changed.
editor.cannotValidate: Your role cannot validate WAF sources (permission admin:waf). Nothing was changed.
editor.createdVersion: Created version {version}. Collection stays off. Validation of version {version} has been requested.
editor.savedLabel: Saved. This was a label change only, so the version and its validation are unchanged.
editor.savedVersion: Saved as version {version}. Collection is paused until it validates. Validation has been requested.
editor.loadedTheirs: Loaded version {version}. Your edits are still in the form; review them against it.
editor.newProfile: A new profile. Nothing is saved yet.
editor.createExplains: The profile is created disabled. Collection from this source stays off until version 1 validates and you enable it. Validation starts now and runs a few bounded searches against QRadar.
editor.mappingExplains: Collection from this source pauses until version {version} validates. Validation starts now and runs a few bounded searches against QRadar.
editor.labelExplains: Only the product label changes. The version, its validation and collection are unaffected.
editor.validatesSaved: Validates the saved version {version}, not your unsaved edits.
editor.validationRequested: Validation of version {version} has been requested.
editor.valuesNote: Which raw {label} values count as {outcomes}. Saving this map is a mapping change: it bumps the version and validates again.
editor.blockedReason: No property is mapped for {label}, so values cannot be assigned yet.
editor.discoveredNote: These values were counted under {seen}; the mapping now reads {now}. Validate again to refresh them.
editor.collectionOff: Collection is disabled. No searches run for this source.
editor.currentNotValid: The current version is not valid.
editor.catalogFailed: The property list could not be refreshed. {reason}
editor.catalogForbidden: Your role cannot read it (permission admin:waf).
editor.catalogPrevious: The previous list is still shown.
editor.copied: Copied from {name} (version {version}). Nothing is saved until you save.
editor.historyFailed: The history could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again; the profile itself is unaffected.

chart.ariaDefault: Requests against the expected range, and endpoint coverage
chart.noBaselineCell: no reliable baseline for this weekday and hour
chart.empty: No request buckets were stored for this endpoint in this window. This is an absence of collection, not an observation of zero requests.
chart.noteRatio: Gaps in the line are buckets whose breakdown was not collected, failed, hit its cap or had no requests to divide. They are not 0 %.
chart.noteVolume: Gaps in the line are buckets that were partial or not stored. They are not zero requests.
chart.noteLower: Some buckets are lower bounds (at least the plotted count).
chart.noteSeasonal: The band follows the baseline cell of each bucket's UTC weekday and hour, and is absent where that cell is missing or not yet reliable.

traffic.notChosenText: No WAF endpoint is set for this widget, so there is nothing to chart.
traffic.notChosenHint: Open Customize, then Configure, to choose one.
traffic.goneText: The WAF endpoint set for this widget is not tracked any more. No other endpoint is drawn in its place.
traffic.goneHint: Open Customize, then Configure, to choose another.
traffic.insufficient: No reliable expected range for this window yet: the baseline cells for these weekdays and hours are still learning. Requests are drawn without a band, and nothing is judged.
traffic.cellsFailed: The expected range could not be read, so none is drawn.
traffic.linkSourcesAria: Open this source's endpoint list. It cannot select this endpoint.
traffic.emptyText: None was stored for this endpoint in the last {range}. That is an absence of collection, not zero requests.
traffic.partialText: No line is drawn; a bucket that was not collected is not zero requests.
traffic.aria: {label} requests per {width} against the expected range, last {range}
traffic.summary: {complete} of {total} stored buckets were fully collected in the last {range}.
